summary.answer: Builds the WZ back HUD children including team/player/ammo/inventory/compass/collapse/reinsertion/death notifications. Spawn selection hides deployable notifications; dead+not hacked+not spawn-select gates DeathCamContainer. Overall caster-profile/spawn-select hides are separate predicates. The constructor wires child source contracts; it does not reconstruct every child, event producer or server state.

summary.answer: Requests InitControllerModelIfNotSet for currentHCStreakName. The supplied helper32–38 reads the controller model and, only when controllerModel[path] is falsey (nil or false), requests create(path) and set("") on the returned value. An existing truthy model handle whose stored value is false does not satisfy this field-truthiness test. Actual model creation, provider types and native results remain unknown. Registered callbacks request text updates only on their delivered nonnil-value paths; text-setting and name-notification hooks do not prove delivery or rendering. Callback39 requests Show when NOT IsModelValueEqualTo(controller,path,""). The helper returns false for a nil model value, so nil can take this negated arm; it is not a guaranteed nonempty-name gate. Native/model/string conversion and callback delivery remain unverified. The text/model lifecycle is conditional on the shared MP HUD caller and original provider.
